_comment: One model per role, no fallbacks. Core generative roles: cybersecurity-specialised <=8B-class models only, chosen by local measurement (docs/MODEL_CARD.md). Standard ML models are separate pipeline components (ml_components), not fallbacks.

role_notes.reason: free-text only (thinking cannot be disabled; JSON-schema tasks fail). Batch for Critical alerts, keep text after </think>.
role_notes.narrate: head-to-head vs foundation-sec:8b-instruct on grounded narratives pending; both hallucinated a number once, so the fact validator is mandatory.

ml_components.cwe_mapping: TF-IDF + LinearSVC (data/models/text_clf.joblib) top-3, LLM adjudicates among candidates
ml_components.cvss_prediction: TF-IDF + LogisticRegression heads (data/models/text_clf.joblib); only when CNA/ADP vector is absent
ml_components.exposure_matching: backend/app/engine/exposure.py (NVD + CNA + text reconciliation, vendor-aware versions)
ml_components.security_ner: cisco-ai/SecureBERT2.0-NER (active: advisory entities) + regex IOC layer
ml_components.attack_mapping: transparent rules CWE/CVE -> ATT&CK techniques with ATT&CK's own mitigations (backend/app/engine/attack.py, local STIX bundle)
ml_components.translation: ai4bharat/indictrans2-en-indic-dist-200M (active: all 22 scheduled languages, own Python 3.14 service :8010; per-sentence validation)
ml_components.log_anomaly: IsolationForest on per-host hourly flow features + robust-z gate on fan-out, ports and bytes (live engine, backend/app/live.py)
ml_components.beacon_detector: RITA-style periodicity / jitter scoring (pipeline and live engine)
ml_components.campaign_clustering: correlation by product of exploited CVEs, chained assets and decoy surges (backend/app/engine/campaigns.py)
ml_components.surge_detector: robust z (median/MAD) on sessions and unique sources per product tag, breadth across sensors (pipeline: daily; live engine: per tick)
ml_components.exploit_forecast: TF-IDF + CVSS/CWE/vendor + leak-free KEV history -> logistic regression (data/models/exploit_forecast.joblib, frozen 2026-07-31)
ml_components.decision_model: Bayesian P(compromise | exposure, exploitation, reachability, telemetry); the day-0 forecast is its prior
ml_components.risk_plan: greedy change-ticket ordering: urgency class, then risk removed per unit of effort (backend/app/engine/riskplan.py)
ml_components.web_attack_detection: HTTP shield inline WAF/IDS: multi-decoder (URL/double-URL/HTML-entity/base64/comment-strip) signature engine over every input surface for SQLi/XSS/traversal/cmdi/SSTI/SSRF/Log4Shell/scanning, plus per-source behavioural detectors for brute force and scanning sweeps (backend/app/engine/webattack.py, backend/app/shield.py). Transparent CWE + ATT&CK per rule; the security LLM gives on-demand analyst explanation, not per-request verdicts (inline inspection must be sub-millisecond and offline).
